note: The board: ten tracked theatres with a dated log of facts per theatre. The morning run appends one entry per theatre that had a reportable event (newest last) with the cited source rows copied into src, and never edits or deletes old entries. No status labels: the page derives activity from the dates. lat/lon place the marker on the schematic map. short = map label; lp = label position (above, below, left, right).

log.t: The six-day Oleshky (Kherson) ceasefire expired 20:59 GMT on 1 Nov; Russia reportedly refused an extension. The Kremlin says three-way talks in Abu Dhabi come after 4 Nov. The State Department approved a $2.1 billion sale of 500 PAC-3 interceptors to Ukraine on 30 Oct. [25, 27, 28]
src: Kherson braces as localised truce ends
Kremlin: Abu Dhabi talks after November 4

log.t: Russia launched 289 drones and 59 cruise missiles overnight; President Zelensky put the ballistic total at 17, and the Energy Ministry says energy sites in 10 regions were hit. [13, 14, 15] Envoy Steve Witkoff says the US will mediate working-level Ukraine–Russia talks in Abu Dhabi on 10–11 Nov. The toll from the bombing of an aid point in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region, rose to 29, with 48 missing. [18, 17]
src: Air defense downs 49 of 59 cruise missiles, 257 of 289 drones overnight; strikes recorded at 23 locations
On U.S. Election Day, Russia launched 17 ballistic missiles and 289 drones at Ukraine, according to Zelenskyy
Russian attack hits energy infrastructure in 10 regions, Energy Ministry says
Ukraine and Russia will hold talks in Abu Dhabi with US mediation
Death toll hits 29 after Russian strike on Ukrainian aid site, with 48 still missing

log.t: Witkoff confirmed US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi on 10–11 Nov, with Medinsky leading Russia's delegation; Russian drones hit a substation serving the Khmelnytskyi nuclear plant. [12, 14]
src: Witkoff reveals location, date for new trilateral peace deal negotiations
Russia targets substation critical to stable operation of Khmelnytskyi NPP

log.t: The IRGC navy says two tankers hit mines in Hormuz on 31 Oct. Qatari-mediated talks broke up 1–2 Nov with a draft still circulating. [28]

A US official called Monday's strike on Qeshm Island a defensive measure against Iranian surface-to-air missiles; IRNA reported that the Revolutionary Guards destroyed a US MQ-9 drone east of the strait. [9, 10] Araghchi says Hormuz reopens on day two if Washington meets Iran's conditions first; Qatari mediators took a draft text to Tehran on 2 Nov. Brent fell 7.6% to $104.77 on Monday. [11, 9, 101]
src: U.S. strikes Iran's Qeshm Island as Vance seeks settlement
US hits Qeshm Island, Pezeshkian signals more diplomacy: Iran war latest
Araghchi says Hormuz could be reopened within two days if conditions met
Crude oil prices sell off more than 7% on Iran peace talk hopes ahead of U.S. midterms

log.t: Qatari mediators await US and Iranian answers to a draft within 36 hours; India says an Indian seafarer was killed in an attack on a dhow near Limah, Oman. [19, 20]
src: Iran, US still far apart on deal to end war as Qatar pushes mediation
Iran and the United States strike Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz

log.t: Gaza civil defence said Israeli attacks killed five people on 2 Nov in Khan Younis, Gaza City and central Gaza; health officials count at least 1,580 killed since the October 2025 ceasefire. Israel's military said it killed six Hamas members for ceasefire violations. [131, 132]
src: Israeli attacks kill five in Gaza Strip

log.t: Gaza's health ministry counts 1,593 killed since the October 2025 ceasefire after five deaths on 2 Nov; Israel asked Lebanon, through the US, to deploy its army and set up checkpoints in Hezbollah areas. [127]
src: Israeli forces kill four in Gaza as fifth Palestinian dies of wounds

log.t: The Saudi-led coalition intercepted a Houthi drone and a ballistic missile aimed at southern Saudi Arabia on 1 Nov; Houthi media reported airstrikes on Ras Isa port and a telecoms site near Saada, with seven wounded at Ras Isa and the Bajil oil facility. Saudi Defence Minister Khalid bin Salman raised the Houthi attacks with Hegseth on 3 Nov. [133, 134, 135]
src: Houthis report airstrikes on Red Sea oil port, telecom facility in Yemen
Saudi forces launch airstrike on port of Ras Isa, Yemen

log.t: The Houthis say Saudi strikes killed 17 people over two days; the Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed a drone over Mecca. [128]

The Fifth Plenum (26–29 Oct) confirmed the expulsion of 33 senior officials, including 16 military officers and former Central Military Commission members Zhang Youxia and Liu Zhenli. Since 13 Oct, navy task groups including the carrier Liaoning have moved through the straits north and south of Taiwan. [64]

Taiwan's air force holds its annual Sky Dragon drills 2–6 Nov, and Kinmen held live-fire drills on 3 Nov. Premier Cho Jung-tai said Taiwan is still seeking a formal invitation to the APEC leaders' meeting in Shenzhen on 18–19 Nov. [26, 27, 28]
src: Taiwan air force holds annual Sky Dragon drills
Taiwan seeking formal APEC invitation from China: Premier

log.t: Taiwan's defence ministry logged 49 Chinese military aircraft sorties, six warships and six government vessels in the 24 hours to 06:00 on 4 Nov. [28]

North Korea fired a tactical ballistic missile with a cluster-bomb warhead on 31 Oct and strategic cruise missiles with a cluster warhead on 2 Nov, according to KCNA, while the Freedom Flag exercise runs at Kunsan to 6 Nov. [24, 25]
src: North Korea tests missile with cluster-bomb warhead
North Korea test-fires strategic cruise missiles: KCNA

log.t: South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff say North Korea fired several missiles from the Sondok area toward the East Sea on 4 Nov, the fourth launch event in a week. [26]
src: North Korea fires 'several missiles' east into the sea

log.t: Drone strikes on 1 Nov destroyed the Al-Dabbah and Abu Hamad substations, days after hits on Shendi and the 500 MW Um Dabakir plant. A rights group counts 15 substations hit since early October; output is down from about 4,400 MW pre-war to 1,100 MW. Khartoum blames the RSF; the UAE denies arming the RSF. [63]
src: Sudan's power grid nears collapse as drone strikes target electric stations

log.t: Drones hit the New Halfa and Aroma stations in Kassala state and Al-Ghazali near Merowe on 2 Nov; Anadolu counts at least 16 stations hit in a week. Sudan filed complaints against Ethiopia at the UN Security Council and the African Union over drones it says came from Ethiopian territory. [22, 23]
src: Drone attacks hit 3 power stations in Sudan, trigger widespread outages
Sudan files complaints against Ethiopia with UN over deadly drone spree

log.t: Sudan's government says 187 drones in 70 attacks came from Ethiopian territory from February to October, killing 176 soldiers and 484 civilians; Ethiopia denies it. [29]
src: Deadly RSF drone strikes reveal deep divisions between Sudan and Ethiopia

log.t: Algerian military personnel escorting fuel trucks reached Agadez, Niger, on the weekend of 1–2 Nov. [129]
src: Niger: Algerian military personnel have arrived in Agadez

log.t: MONUSCO's head met Joseph Kabila, leader of a rebel coalition that includes M23, in Goma on 3 Nov; more than 100,000 people marched for peace in Uvira on 4 Nov. [30, 31]
src: UN peacekeeping head meets leaders of rebel coalition in eastern DRC
Plus de 100 000 personnes marchent à Uvira pour exiger la paix

log.t: Secretary of State Marco Rubio met Venezuelan Foreign Minister Oliver Blanco on 2 Nov; the State Department set out a “three-phase plan for Venezuela: stabilization, economic recovery and political reconciliation, and democratic transition.” [130]
src: US urges Venezuela to follow phased plan for democratic transition
